name: separated
grammar: grammar ExceptionProbe { @package: exceptionprobe @whitespace: none @tokenAdapter: { id: 'exception.item' version: '1' java: 'exceptionprobe.Item' rust: 'crate::item' } @tokenAdapter: { id: 'exception.separator' version: '1' java: 'exceptionprobe.Separator' rust: 'crate::separator' } token I=ADAPTER('exception.item',version=1) token S=ADAPTER('exception.separator',version=1) @root @mapping(Value,params=[items]) Root ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(word,I) % Sep) @items '!'; @skip Sep ::= S; }

name: nested-list
grammar: grammar ExceptionProbe { @package: exceptionprobe @whitespace: none @tokenAdapter: { id: 'exception.item' version: '1' java: 'exceptionprobe.Item' rust: 'crate::item' } @tokenAdapter: { id: 'exception.separator' version: '1' java: 'exceptionprobe.Separator' rust: 'crate::separator' } token I=ADAPTER('exception.item',version=1) token S=ADAPTER('exception.separator',version=1) @root @nestedCaptures @mapping(Value,params=[items]) Root ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE({ CAPTURE(word,I) }) @items '!'; }
